title: Build JakeAI Baseline Change-Control Engine
purpose: Add deterministic branch lineage, change declaration, risk classification, review-lane, authorization, and full-gate enforcement for future JakeAI work without modifying main or the historical baseline anchor.
unresolved_conditions: Hardened change-control candidate must pass its own gate and the full Master Baseline regression suite at the exact reviewed head.
Council/security review must close the initial under-declared-risk, authorization-state, and unclassified-path findings before baseline-v2 designation.
evidence: Initial gate at 91ec62cd02d98f07e698b03df304fa77ecff4425 passed before adversarial Council review.
Council review identified three hardening opportunities: minimum risk enforcement, authorization review-state enforcement, and fail-closed handling of unclassified changed paths.
Hardening changes add policy-driven minimum risk levels, require approved review lanes before any authorization=true state, fail on unclassified changed paths, and add adversarial regression tests.
